map.抗张撕裂强度 使用指南: Tensile and Tear Strength User Guide
map.输入试片宽度、厚度与断裂、撕裂载荷，计算抗张强度（MPa）与撕裂强度（N/mm）: Enter specimen width, thickness, and breaking and tear loads to compute tensile strength (MPa) and tear strength (N/mm) and evaluate the leather's mechanical performance.
map.按试样宽度、厚度与断裂负荷计算抗张强度，按撕裂力与厚度计算撕裂强度。: Compute tensile strength from specimen width, thickness, and breaking load, and tear strength from tear force and thickness.
map.判定皮革力学性能等级，确认是否满足鞋面、箱包等用途要求。: Grade the leather's mechanical performance and confirm whether it meets the requirements for uppers, luggage, and similar uses.
map.对比不同部位或工艺批次的强度差异，排查质量问题。: Compare strength differences across body parts or process batches to troubleshoot quality issues.
map.：截面积(mm²) = 试样宽度(mm) × 厚度(mm)；抗张强度(MPa): : cross-sectional area (mm²) = specimen width (mm) × thickness (mm); tensile strength (MPa) = breaking load (N) ÷ area (mm²) (1 N/mm² = 1 MPa); tear strength (N/mm) = tear force (N) ÷ thickness (mm). Tensile grades: 20 MPa and above excellent, 15–20 good, 10–15 pass, under 10 poor.
map.：试样宽 10 mm、厚 1.5 mm：截面积 = 15 mm²。断裂负荷 24: : a specimen 10 mm wide and 1.5 mm thick gives an area of 15 mm². A breaking load of 240 N → tensile strength = 240/15 = 16 MPa, rated "good" and meeting most upper requirements. A tear force of 45 N → tear strength = 45/1.5 = 30 N/mm.
map.为什么抗张强度要除以截面积？: Why Divide Tensile Strength by the Cross-Sectional Area?
map.断裂负荷是力，同样材质的厚试样需要更大的力才能拉断；除以截面积得到的强度（应力）: Breaking load is a force, and a thicker specimen of the same material needs a larger force to break; only dividing by the cross-sectional area to get strength (stress) allows fair comparison across specimens of different thickness.
map.撕裂强度单位是 N/mm 怎么理解？: How Should I Understand the Tear Strength Unit N/mm?
map.它表示使已有裂口继续扩展所需的力与厚度的比值，反映皮革抵抗撕裂扩展的能力，单位长: It is the ratio of the force needed to extend an existing tear to the thickness, reflecting the leather's resistance to tear propagation — the greater the force sustained per unit length, the better.
